title: A Postcards for the Silence
author: Jude Thackeray
blurb: Tamsin Sterling, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the demolition date arrives.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
